_note: 學習路徑內容建置首批增量 #4／6：健康與身體不適（eng.t_mid.vocab.health-illness，會考級 vocab）。核心用法：have a + 病症（have a cold／fever／headache／cough）；take medicine（不是 eat/drink）；rest and see a doctor。只教語言用法與普世安全常識（休息、看醫生），不給劑量或醫療處方（避免醫療風險；claims 均 language-usage/definition、risk normal）。待對抗式英語母語複核。teach 與 practice 皆兌現 KP id。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix heal_）。

units.can_do: 我能用英語說身體不舒服（have a cold／fever／headache／cough），並說 take medicine、rest、see a doctor。
units.situation_group: 說身體不舒服 Feeling ill
units.subject: eng

claims.text: In English we usually say 'have a + illness' for common sicknesses: have a cold, have a fever, have a headache, have a cough.
claims.verification_ref: have a + 病症（cold/fever/headache/cough）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: A 'cold' is a common minor illness that makes you sneeze and gives you a runny or blocked nose and a sore throat.
claims.verification_ref: cold=感冒（打噴嚏、流鼻水）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: A 'fever' is a body temperature that is higher than normal, which often happens when you are ill.
claims.verification_ref: fever=發燒（體溫比平常高）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: A 'headache' is a pain in your head.
claims.verification_ref: headache=頭痛；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The usual verb for using medicine is 'take medicine' (take some medicine), not 'eat' or 'drink' medicine.
claims.verification_ref: take medicine（非 eat/drink medicine）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: To 'rest' means to stop activity and relax so your body can get better; to 'see a doctor' means to visit a doctor for help when you are ill.
claims.verification_ref: rest=休息；see a doctor=看醫生（普世安全常識，非處方）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: To say you feel sick, English often uses have a + illness: have a cold, have a fever, have a headache, and have a cough.
teach.zh_hint: 說身體不舒服，英語常用 have a + 病症：have a cold（感冒）、have a fever（發燒）、have a headache（頭痛）、have a cough（咳嗽）。

teach.body: I have a cold, so I keep sneezing. She has a fever and feels very hot.
teach.zh_hint: 我感冒了，所以一直打噴嚏。她發燒，覺得很熱。

teach.body: For taking medicine, say take medicine (not eat medicine or drink medicine). When you feel sick, you can rest, see a doctor, and then get better.
teach.zh_hint: 吃藥用 take medicine（不是 eat／drink medicine）。不舒服時可以 rest（休息）、see a doctor（看醫生），然後 get better（好起來）。

teach.body: You should take some medicine and rest. If you don't feel better, see a doctor.
teach.zh_hint: 你應該吃點藥、休息。如果沒好轉，去看醫生。

teach.body: He has a headache after reading for too long.

practice.stem: 「我一直打噴嚏，我想我感冒了」哪一句對？
practice.answer: I think I have a cold.
options: I think I have a cold.
I think I am a cold.
I think I do a cold.
I think I make a cold.

感冒要用 have a cold，不是 am a cold。
沒有 make a cold 的說法；要用 have a cold。

practice.feedback: 病症用 have a + 名詞：have a cold（感冒）。

practice.stem: 她的身體摸起來很燙、體溫比平常高。她有什麼？

distractor_rationales.cough: cough 是咳嗽，和『身體很燙』不同。
distractor_rationales.headache: headache 是頭痛，不是體溫很高。
distractor_rationales.stomachache: stomachache 是肚子痛，不是體溫很高。

practice.feedback: fever＝發燒，體溫比平常高（She has a fever.）。

practice.stem: 他看書看太久，現在頭很痛。他有什麼？

distractor_rationales.cold: cold 是感冒（打噴嚏、流鼻水），不是頭痛。
distractor_rationales.fever: fever 是發燒（體溫高），不是頭痛。

practice.feedback: headache＝頭痛（a pain in your head）。

practice.stem: 「吃藥」英語道地的說法是哪一個？

distractor_rationales.eat medicine: 藥不用 eat；道地說法是 take medicine。
distractor_rationales.drink medicine: 即使是藥水，英語也用 take medicine，不用 drink medicine。
distractor_rationales.do medicine: 沒有 do medicine 的說法。

practice.feedback: 吃藥用 take medicine（take some medicine）。

practice.stem: 把對的字填進去：You look tired and sick. You should ____ and you will get better.（你看起來又累又不舒服，應該休息，就會好起來。）

distractor_rationales.run: 生病時應該休息，不是去跑步（run）。
distractor_rationales.jump: 生病時不是去跳（jump）；要 rest 休息。
distractor_rationales.shout: shout 是大叫，和生病要休息不合。

practice.feedback: rest＝休息，讓身體好起來（You should rest.）。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: I have a fever, so I should see a doctor.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：I、have、a、fever、so、I、should、see、a、doctor、逗號和句點有沒有漏。have a fever＝發燒。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。都是陳述句，句尾自然下收；have a cold／have a fever 連著唸順。

lines.text: I have a cold, so I keep sneezing.
You should take some medicine and rest.
